api.finite_orbit: audit_feasible_orbit checks an explicitly supplied feasible orbit exactly
api.model_growth: assert_added verifies that the serialized model actually grew
api.named_witness: audit_named_witnesses checks rejected and surviving base-feasible assignments in linear time
api.small_exact: assert_cuts_small_exact returns a verdict only after complete enumeration

boundary: Witness and orbit audits do not count all feasible assignments and do not predict solver runtime.
theorem: Full-scale non-vacuity can be certified without enumerating the unknown solution set: a named base-feasible assignment is rejected, an equivalent base-feasible representative survives, and model growth is checked. Exact solution-count claims remain restricted to terminating small models or an explicitly supplied finite orbit.
